service.en: Withdraw a domestic worker absconding report (employer)
service.ar: سحب بلاغ تغيب عامل خدمة منزلية (صاحب العمل)
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کی غیر حاضری رپورٹ واپس لینا (آجر)

about: Let an employer cancel an absconding report filed against a domestic worker.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: An absconding report must already exist against the worker
fees: Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
